title: DefinitionValue
description: Value posted onto the Definition panel (engine-owned, GSM-spine). 'Definition' is named to align with GSM semantics: this panel decides which source items collectively define one GSM subject (Structure, Mechanism, Effector, Receptor, Interaction, Archetype, Directive, Norm). It is the join key for every other target panel. Note on merge precedence: Definition.Merge is identity-time merging (a ReconciliationKS asserts that two surface keys describe the same subject BEFORE Statement shaping). Granularity.mergeWith is post-statement consolidation (a GranularityKS asserts that two distinct subjects, after their Statements were shaped, should collapse into one). When both apply to the same identity, the later (Granularity.mergeWith) wins because it is a more informed decision; the engine cascades supersedence over the earlier Definition.Merge via Override Cascader.

slot.description: Closed contribution-type slot. 'Claim' = an IdentificationKS asserts an identity; 'Merge' = a ReconciliationKS asserts that prior identities are the same subject.

identityKey.description: Stable identity key for the GSM subject (Pack-defined naming convention).

supportingSourceIds.description: Ids of SourceUnit / SourceInterface / SourceInventory contributions supporting this Definition.

supersedesIdentityKeys.description: Required when slot = Merge: prior identityKeys absorbed by this merge.
